criteria.text: A failed ensureGlobalStream() schedules a retry with bounded exponential backoff (e.g. 1s -> 30s cap) that continues until a subscription succeeds or shutdown is requested.
The retry survives repeated consecutive failures — N failures in a row must not disarm it.
On entering the failed state, opencodeEventHub.setLive(false) so mobile falls back correctly; set back to true on recovery.
Recovery runs the same reconcile path as resubscribeGlobalStream (reconcileSessionStatuses, recoverPendingQuestions, recoverPendingPermissions) so asks orphaned during the gap are picked up.
The dead-stream state is user-visible — a degraded/reconnecting indicator rather than silent hangs.
Test: stub subscribeToGlobalEvents to throw once then succeed; assert a live subscription without any streamSession() call. Second test: throw 3x then succeed.

After SIGTERM, wait for /opencode/health unavailable, bridgeLive false, and a reconnecting message; invoke tools/dev/sandbox.sh restart-engine; assert the API PID is unchanged while engine PID and bootId change and bridge health recovers.
criteria.reason: The live file passed 1/1: degraded/reconnecting health was observed, API PID 57023 stayed unchanged, engine PID and bootId changed, and bridge health recovered.

criteria.text: After recovery, create a parent through POST /agent-sessions and an engine child through POST /session, observe the real session.created frame on /ws/agents, and observe the child persist through the public sessions API.
criteria.reason: The same 1/1 live run observed the post-recovery WebSocket child event and the child persisted through the public sessions API.

criteria.text: The sandbox restart-engine command refuses unowned processes, preserves the API PID, replaces and records the owned engine PID with isolated runtime environment, appends logs, and remains cleanable by down.
